family: The SAME total uniform P language F_N=family.evaluate on ALL N actual bits, defined fully in family.py. d_N is its fixed public controller's original minimum geometry dimension; fallback is output0,d_N=N+1. Its fixed empty-witness NP verifier is given in proof.md.
theorem: At acceptance let a_0=0<...<a_hp=H be active depths, c_u=ceil(N/2^V_(a_u)), T_u=2^(V_(a_(u+1))-V_(a_u)). I_u and O are the public exact inner/outer maxima defined in proof.md, Stronger certificate. Set B_hp=c_hp and B_u=min(c_u,B_(u+1)+(T_u-2)(I_u-1)+max(I_u,O)-1); f_N=B_0+1, otherwise f_N=N+1. The full B2 bound C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8f_N+8 holds for EVERY integer N>=0. At acceptance f_N<=e_N<d_N, where e_N is the symmetric Q capacity threshold explicitly defined in proof.md; f_N<e_N whenever Q is odd. At EVERY sufficiently large integer length, d_N<=2^ceil(DZ), D=8818127579/2000000000, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)), L=ceil(log2 N), B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Also limsup log2(d_N)/Z<=Cstar6<=440906378851/100000000000, where Cstar6=inf_(S6)(w0+X) and S6 is explicitly defined in proof.md. For each fixed real epsilon>0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer N; this SAME family has liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4.
